findings.text: The auto-generated __rich_repr__ iterates over all __init__ parameters including 'self', then calls getattr(self, 'self') at line 111 (or 105 for POSITIONAL_ONLY), which raises AttributeError since instances don't have a 'self' attribute. Any class using @auto without explicit __rich_repr__ will fail when repr() is called.

0.reason: The code iterates over signature parameters, and 'self' is excluded because inspect.signature on a bound method (self.__init__) omits the self parameter, so getattr(self, 'self') is never called.
